children: Finance platform BILL will be acquired in a deal worth about $6 billion, with TPG set to buy a majority stake and Corpay agreeing to buy a minority interest.
Starboard Value, BILL's largest stockholder, has agreed to vote in favor of the $63.25-a-share deal.
BILL shares closed at $57.63 on Monday and surged after the Financial Times reported that TPG was near a BILL deal. The stock was recently down 3% after hours Thursday, at $61.95.
